name: io.github.burmanharry/climatch
title: Climatch
description: Find places with a climate like yours, compare towns' weather by month, and see what grows where.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Towns matching a name, most populous first, with ids and slugs the other tools accept. Use it when a name is ambiguous (Springfield, San Jose) to pick the right one.

q.description: Town name, optionally with region or country: "san jose, costa rica"

tools.name: get_climate
tools.description: A town's climate: a one-line summary and a paragraph, the 12 monthly averages (high, low, rain, humidity, sun), the most and least pleasant months, a 0–100 nice-weather score, cost of living when known, and links. Temperatures in °C and °F, rain in mm and inches.

place.description: Town name ("Lisbon", "Portland, Oregon"), Climatch slug ("portland-oregon") or GeoNames id. The most populous match wins

tools.name: find_similar_climates
tools.description: Towns whose climate is most like a town's, best match first, optionally 'but warmer / cooler / drier / sunnier / less humid', for one month, or within some countries or continents. Each match has its 0–100 score, how it differs, and links. Defaults match the Climatch app: year-round, abroad only, 25,000+ people.

place.description: Town name ("Lisbon", "Portland, Oregon"), Climatch slug ("portland-oregon") or GeoNames id. The most populous match wins

adjust.description: Like the place, but… Stack freely, except warmer with cooler

month.description: Compare one calendar month only (e.g. where is July like Lisbon's July). Default: the whole year

exclude_home_country.description: Leave out the place's own country. Default true

countries.description: Only these ISO country codes, e.g. ["ES","PT"]

continents.description: Only these continents: AF AS EU NA OC SA

tools.name: compare_climates
tools.description: Two towns side by side: their 0–100 climate match, a few sentences on how they differ, and both sets of monthly averages. When seasonsFlipped, B's months are shifted 6 in alignedB so July lines up with January. Temperatures in °C and °F, rain in mm and inches.

tools.name: best_weather_in_month
tools.description: The 30 large towns with the most comfortable weather in a month (afternoon highs near 24°C / 75°F, little rain, low humidity), spread across countries. From the ~2,000 most populous towns.

tools.name: weather_for_the_money
tools.description: Cities of 500,000+ ranked by how much nicer their weather is than their cost of living predicts (value), with a 0–100 nice-weather score and cost of living (US = 100). Quadrants: sweet (fine weather, affordable), pricey, tough (cheap, harder climate), other. Countries under a US 'do not travel' advisory are left out.

tools.name: what_grows_here
tools.description: Crops ranked by how well a town's or a map point's climate suits them (0–100), with what limits each, whether it needs irrigation, and the growing climate: hardiness zone, frost dates, chill hours, rain, dry season. Climate only: no soil, pests or markets.

place.description: Town. Or pass lat and lon for any land point

tools.name: list_crops
tools.description: The crops and varieties Climatch scores, with the slugs what_grows_here and where_to_grow use.

tools.name: where_to_grow
tools.description: Where in the world a crop (or one variety) suits the climate: land area that fits well, the best regions and countries, the best-fitting towns, and what stops it elsewhere. Scored on a 0.125° land grid. Climate only.

crop.description: Crop slug from list_crops, e.g. avocado

variety.description: Variety slug from list_crops. Default: the best variety at each place
